newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Ispat confirms shares to be offered at $22 to $26.
newsitem.headline: Ispat confirms shares to be offered at $22 to $26.

text.p: Steel group Ispat International NV confirmed on Friday earlier reports that it would float 19.25 million of its shares in Amsterdam and New York at a price of $22 to $26 each.

The underwriters of the initial public offering have an option to buy an additional 2.89 million shares, Ispat said. The IPO represents a stake of about 16 percent in the group which is now owned by British businessman Lakshmi Mittal.
Ispat said a reorganisation would take place before the flotation, in which certain steel making assets of its controlling stakeholder would be transferred to Ispat.
Ispat is officially based in the Netherlands and produces steel in Canada, Ireland, Germany, Mexico and the Caribbean, utilising the "integrated mini-mill process".

The group produces a broad range of semifinished and finished steel products for both the flat product and long product markets. In 1996, Ispat posted net profit of $613 million on sales of $1.8 billion.
Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corporation and Credit Suisse First Boston Corporation are the joint global coordinators and joint book-runners of the IPO.
